description: This file defines an internal interface IStreamControl that provides management operations for streams, such as cleanup functions within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: IStreamControl
classes.description: An interface for stream management operations, specifically for cleanup procedures without dependence on concrete generic stream types.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations on the stream, including cleanup of producers and consumers, and returns a Task representing the asynchronous operation.
